title: Firmness in Action
note: He defines this as the firmness of mind needed by someone who is to carry clean work through to its end.

couplets.plain: Firmness in action is a person’s firmness of mind. Everything else is something else.
couplets.pm: What is called firmness in work is firmness in the mind of the one who is to finish it. The strength of armies, forts, friendships and the like can’t be called that. They are needed and belong with it, so he says “the rest”. Without it they are of no use, so he says “something else”.

links.quote: Firmness in action is a person’s firmness of mind
links.reason: Says firmness in action is nothing but firmness of mind.

couplets.plain: Avoiding harm, and not giving way once it comes: those who have looked into it say these two are the path.
couplets.pm: The learned say the settled view of ministers who studied statecraft runs along these two: not doing work that will go wrong, and not weakening when god spoils the work you do. This sums up what the ministers of the gods and the demons taught, so it includes clean action too. He rejects the variant ஊறொரார், which doesn’t fit a count of two.

links.quote: not giving way once it comes
links.reason: Half the rule of those who have looked into it is not to give way once harm comes.

couplets.plain: Real strength is to do the work so that it shows only at the end. If it shows midway, it brings trouble that won’t go.
couplets.pm: Firmness is to do the work in secret all along, so that it comes to light only at the end. If it shows midway, the doer gets suffering he can’t shake off. Others mustn’t learn how it was planned, or guess from his gestures, looks, acts and words. Enemies who know early will block the work or the man.

links.quote: so that it shows only at the end

couplets.plain: Saying it is easy for anyone. Doing it as you said is hard.
couplets.pm: To set out in order “We will do this work in this way” is easy for anyone. To do it that way is hard for anyone. Even those without firmness can plan hard things and speak of them, so he says “easy”.

links.quote: Doing it as you said is hard

couplets.plain: The firmness in action of those who have risen to excellence reaches the ruler and is held in mind.
couplets.pm: The firmness of ministers who excel in thought and in their other marks is esteemed by all, because it reaches the ruler. It reaches him when the work is finished through it, and the wealth and fame become his. “Held in mind” means not forgotten, out of esteem.

links.quote: firmness in action of those who have risen to excellence
links.reason: The firmness of the excellent reaches the ruler and earns lasting regard.

couplets.plain: Those who plan will get what they planned, just as they planned it, if they are firm.
couplets.pm: Those who have planned will get all they planned to get, just as they planned it and with ease, if they are firm in the work that leads there. They plan only well, so if they are firm the work is finished, and once it is, everything comes to hand.

links.reason: Firmness gets what was planned, in the way it was planned.

couplets.plain: Don’t scorn people for how they look. There are those who are the axle pin of the great rolling chariot.
couplets.pm: The world has people firm in work, like the pin on the axle of a great rolling chariot, so don’t scorn them for being small. The pin that keeps the wheel on is small, yet firm enough to carry a great load. In the same way there are ministers, small in form, who carry great tasks. Know them by that firmness.

links.quote: Don’t scorn people for how they look
the axle pin of the great rolling chariot
links.reason: The small axle pin carries the great chariot, as an unimpressive person may.

couplets.plain: Once you have settled on a task with a clear mind, don’t waver or delay. Do it.
couplets.pm: Once your mind is clear and you have resolved on a task, do it without wavering and without dragging it out. To a confused mind, what should be dropped can look like what should be done. So he means work examined clearly many times and then decided on. Not wavering is firmness.

links.reason: Once the choice is clearly made, forbids wavering and delay.

couplets.plain: Even if great pain comes, be resolute and do the work that brings joy.
couplets.pm: Even if your bodily effort brings great suffering at first, don’t weaken at it, but firmly do the work that brings joy at the end. Only the unshaken can look past the passing pain of effort to the lasting joy that follows.

links.quote: be resolute and do the work that brings joy
links.reason: Asks for resolve in work that brings joy, whatever pain comes.

couplets.plain: However firm they are in other ways, the world doesn’t want those who don’t want firmness in action.
couplets.pm: Ministers who don’t value firmness in action, though they have every other firmness, are not esteemed by the great. Without firmness of mind, even strong armies, forts and friendships won’t finish the work, and all of it is lost.

links.remove: The Tamil speaks of firmness in action, not of ambition or great deeds. Aspiration came from the old English.

links.quote: the world doesn’t want those who don’t want firmness in action
